ashley: Quick q — thinking about default TTLs / tombstone semantics for flags. We want safe staged deprecations but not to keep stale entries forever. should console auto-tombstone after X days?

sam: We should avoid forever-growing indexes. default tombstone = 120d seems reasonable. deprecation window shorter, like 30d.

dmitri: +1 on two-phase. propose fields: deprecation_after_days and tombstone_after_days. example PATCH: 
```
PATCH /v1/configs/flags/resize-mode
{
  "deprecation_after_days": 30,
  "tombstone_after_days": 120,
  "rollout_strategy": "cohort"
}
```

liz: UX/telemetry note: if we actually remove flag rows on tombstone, dashboards that join on flag id will break historical charts. we either need to keep a sampled mapping or materialize a tombstone marker that dashboards can still join against. :thinking:

ashley: Good point. what's the storage hit for keeping a sampled mapping? can we keep high-fidelity for critical flags and sample others?

dmitri: We can do tiered retention: full history for tags (e.g., critical,billing), sampled for others. Rough config: 
```
{
  "history_retention_days": 180,
  "full_history_for_tags": ["critical", "billing"],
  "sample_rate_percent": 1
}
```
That keeps dashboards working while bounding cost.

sam: Works, but console needs to show which flags are sampled vs full. otherwise users will be confused when their old data seems missing. we should show a badge and a hint.

liz: UI idea: timeline with shaded region for "deprecation window" and a cross/ghost marker for tombstone. tooltip "history sampled" when applicable. also add a small banner on flag settings if it's subject to auto-tombstone.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: config-schema migration v2 scheduled. dry-run on canary tenants at 2026-04-02T08:00Z. Notify owner(s): ashley, dmitri.

ashley: Action items: i'll draft RFC + migration plan. defaults i'm leaning to: deprecation_after=30d, tombstone_after=120d, history_retention_sampled=180d, sample_rate=1%. will include opt-out per tenant. pinging @dmitri @liz for review. :+1:

dmitri: ack, i'll review and add migration steps for the history sampler.

sam: add tenant-level opt-out flag `preserve_history`: true in API so enterprise customers can keep everything.

liz: i'll prototype the timeline mock and the badge copy.

ashley: cool — i'll post the RFC in #eng-platform tomorrow. thanks all. :rocket:
